stories.title: Trump anuncia que creará una fuerza de IA en vez de frenarla

en.title: Trump announces he will create an AI force instead of restraining it
en.summary: US President Donald Trump warned critics of artificial intelligence and data centers that he will not permit the destruction of the industry.

stories.title: Nueva caída del Cruz Azul; pierde 1-0 ante Monterrey

en.title: Cruz Azul falls again; loses 1-0 to Monterrey
en.summary: Cruz Azul suffered a second consecutive defeat, losing 1-0 to Monterrey and missing the chance to finish in the top three of the Apertura 2026 tournament, days after losing the Campeones Cup title.

stories.title: La deuda de Francia llegará a un récord de 122% del PIB

en.title: France's debt will reach a record 122% of GDP
en.summary: France's public debt is projected to reach record levels in 2026 and 2027 at approximately 122 percent of GDP, according to the Finance Ministry, following a proposed 62 billion dollar fiscal adjustment.

stories.title: EU y Dinamarca firmarán durante Asamblea de la ONU pacto sobre Groenlandia

en.title: US and Denmark will sign agreement on Greenland during UN Assembly
en.summary: Denmark's Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen will travel to New York to sign a security pact with the United States regarding Greenland during the UN General Assembly annual session.

stories.title: Rescata Borja al América con doblete; queda Clásico empatado

en.title: Borja rescues América with a brace; Classic ends tied
en.summary: Miguel Borja scored twice in three minutes to help América draw 2-2 against Guadalajara in the Classic match.

stories.title: América viene de atrás y rescata empate ante Chivas en una vibrante edición del Clásico Nacional

en.title: América comes from behind and rescues draw against Chivas in vibrant National Classic edition
en.summary: América recovered from a deficit to secure a draw against Guadalajara in the National Classic at Estadio Banorte.

en.summary: Alejandra Guzmán experienced a hip dislocation during a concert performance in Veracruz and was hospitalized.

en.title: First setback for Rafa Márquez in Mexican National Team; loses key staff member

en.title: LIVE | Second 2026 National Drill: Follow minute-by-minute coverage of Saturday, September 19 exercise
en.summary: Mexico's second national earthquake simulation drill took place on September 19 at 12:00 central time. The exercise tested emergency preparedness and response coordination across the country.

stories.title: Trump no tolerará los intentos de frenar el desarrollo de la IA

en.summary: The president rejects growing societal skepticism toward artificial intelligence, which has been fueled by warnings about potential dangers to humanity.

en.summary: The streaming platform faces user complaints about increasingly restrictive measures being implemented on its service.

stories.title: 10 millones de dispositivos y menos de cinco segundos, la carrera de SkyAlert ante un sismo

en.title: 10 million devices and less than five seconds, SkyAlert's race against an earthquake
en.summary: SkyAlert's earthquake alert system uses sensors, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to detect earthquakes and distribute alerts to millions of devices in seconds. The technology analyzes potential impact before sending notifications.

stories.title: Registro telefónico llega a 54.7%, mientras las fallas en plataformas aún complican la vinculación

en.title: Telephone Registration Reaches 54.7%, While Platform Failures Continue to Complicate Linking
en.summary: More than half of active telephone lines are now registered, but technical issues with platforms persist in hindering users from completing the linking process.

stories.title: Tim Hortons reta a Starbucks con tazas de Halloween y se adelanta al vaso de Snoopy

en.title: Tim Hortons challenges Starbucks with Halloween cups and gets ahead of Snoopy glass
en.summary: Tim Hortons launched Halloween-themed cups before Starbucks, with both coffee chains using limited-edition collectible cups as a strategy to attract customers and increase sales.
